channelAfter.description:
Wonder Hollow makes gentle preschool learning videos for children aged 3–5. Join Mossy the koala, Tilly the quokka, Rufus the kookaburra and Bimble the bilby to explore counting, letter sounds, science, nature and feelings, one idea at a time.

Watch together with a grown-up, pause to answer and try an activity away from the screen.

For parents and carers:
Free preschool learning games: https://wonder-hollow.com/
Learning topics and activities: https://wonder-hollow.com/learning.html

before.title: Four, Then Five
before.description:
After three comes four, then five, one for each finger. Bimble and Tilly hold up fingers and sort groups to find which ones show five.

Try this after the video: Count five toys into a box, one at a time.

before.title: One, Two, Three
before.description:
We can count things: one, two, three. Bimble and Tilly sing a counting song and find things to count all around them.

Try this after the video: Find three of something in your house and count them out loud.

before.title: One Whole Hand And More
before.description:
A gentle counting song from Wonder Hollow. Mossy holds up one whole hand and shows that after five come six, seven and eight, growing finger by finger onto the other hand. Rufus guesses purple, pancakes and eleventy, tumbles into the moss, and laughs while the children put him right. A short refrain returns three times so little ones can join in and count along.

Try this after the video: Line up eight pebbles, blocks, or spoons and count them one by one.
